name: Autódromo Internacional do Algarve
coordinates: x east, z south, y up; meters
bank_convention: Positive bank raises the geometric left road edge relative to center

metadata.layout: OSM layout (the full Torre VIP loop, matching the shape of the official MotoGP map); its length (4640 m) matches the 4.653 km car Grand Prix circuit, not the 4.592 km MotoGP layout. NOT the verified MotoGP layout.

length_reference.reason: The OSM geometry (ways tagged with a Wikimedia schematic as source) measures within 0.3% of the car Grand Prix length; the 4.592 km motorcycle variant is not mapped in OSM and could not be verified.

metadata.purpose: held-out test track: never used for training the general SAC policy; built to measure generalization

start_finish.source: OSM node 5006082198 (raceway=start); in the DGT Ortos2025 orthophoto it lies on a transverse white line across the pit straight with faint grid slot marks behind it

width.status: Measured from orthoimagery pavement colour; median 27 m and Gaussian 6 m smoothed; gaps interpolated
